source: Read-only accepted Origo native records; original book, execution and aggregate observations.
notes: Micro JSON retains exact selected native pins and original clocks. Main chart protocol harness derives its cube from genuine executions, encoded in its existing cents/satoshis/time-ms units; it generates no trades. The eight-minute excerpt is not evidence for the remainder of a day. Main-chart timestamps floor to supported integer milliseconds, preserving all cube-cell membership; Micro retains original book microseconds.
book_normal: Preceding-hour original native book samples; exact selected baseline partitions are included in overview.sources.book. At least 1800 observed eligible seconds; quotes received after their minute close are excluded from that baseline.

later_overview.source: Read-only supported Origo Micro API on 5f72b2695ab0b4f8e65a5311d14f866c01f5ae4f; original accepted identities and clocks retained. Multi-page retention boundary; no main-chart executions are generated for this later interval.
